Our multi-disciplinary Research and Development organization combines state-of-the-art resources with world-class expertise in therapeutic discovery and development. We are inspired by the belief that a research-driven enterprise dedicated to scientific excellence can create medicines and vaccines that save and improve lives. Grounded in a culture of respect, invention, and collaboration, our organization offers a dynamic environment where you can build on a proud legacy of scientific breakthroughs while advancing your career.
  
  
Modeling and Informatics (M&I) is an inclusive group of approximately 50 computational chemists and data scientists within our global Discovery Chemistry organization. With a strong track record of pipeline impact, we apply cutting-edge capabilities in structure-based modeling and predictive science to advance drug design and development worldwide. With an unbiased approach to drug modalities, in-house access to the newest screening techniques, and world-class medicinal chemistry, we have a wealth of opportunities to impact our pipeline and ultimately save and improve patient lives.
  
  
We are seeking an exceptional, highly motivated computational scientist to join our Research Laboratories in South San Francisco, California. The ideal candidate combines strong interpersonal and problem-solving skills with deep expertise across AI/ML, computer science, biophysics, and computational chemistry, alongside a passion for applying innovative methods to complex scientific challenges. This role focuses on building algorithms, tools, and workflows that integrate predictive modeling, agentic scientific reasoning, and physics-based insight. * Bachelor’s (with 7+ years), Master’s (with 4+ years) or Ph.D. (or Ph.D. completion by June 2027 ) in Engineering, Computer Science, Machine Learning, Chemistry, Computational Chemistry, Biophysics, Applied Mathematics or a related discipline and relevant experience.

* Broad competency in modern data science.
* Research experience applying the deep learning approaches to chemistry or biophysics problems.

* Strong Python skills for scientific programming, methods development, and algorithm development on Linux high performance compute.

At Sunrun, we’re on a mission to change the way the world interacts with energy, and we’re building a company and brand that puts power at the center of life. To do it, we’re designing a dynamic culture where employee development, well-being, and safety come first. It’s why we’ve become the #1 home solar and battery company in America. We’re unlike any other residential energy company. Our vertically integrated model gives us total control over every part of the energy lifecycle – from sale through installation and beyond – so you can find endless opportunities for growth. Come join a career you can grow in and a culture you can run with.  
  
Who We Are

We’re on a mission to make energy more reliable and affordable for more people. We provide an opportunity with storage and solar to help people access greater energy independence without the big upfront costs. Sunrun is the largest dedicated residential solar and storage company in the country and has a mission to bring stably priced resilient power to the masses.

As a leader at Sunrun, you’ll bring our leadership principles to life by creating the experience, leading by example, and communicating well & often. You’ll lead by example to integrate AI tools into your daily routines and champion the responsible adoption of AI. Empower your team to explore these tools and build AI skills to improve efficiency and decision quality in their work. You’ll keep score to drive results, develop people to help them grow, and build a deliberate safety-focused culture where our values shine: We Love People, We Love to Create, and We Love to Run. Most importantly, you’ll attract and retain top talent to help Sunrun build the best team on the planet. Together, we run.

### **POSITION SUMMARY**

Sunrun is the undisputed leader in residential clean energy, pioneering the multi-billion-dollar solar-as-a-subscription asset class. We don’t just install solar hardware; we originate, scale, and manage a decentralized energy infrastructure network. By transforming residential roofs into networked virtual power plants and intelligent grid assets, Sunrun is fundamentally rewriting the mechanics of whole-home electrification and energy distribution. Our organization thrives on high-velocity commercial performance, disciplined operational scaling, and an unwavering commitment to maintaining the absolute best talent engine in the climate-tech sector. For executive revenue leaders, Sunrun offers the complexity of an enterprise infrastructure business paired with the agility of a high-growth platform.

We are seeking a highly technical, efficiency-minded Senior Manager of Data Science & Analytics to lead, reshape, and scale our business intelligence and analytics functions.

Currently, 20 to 30 analysts are embedded across various business units. You will serve as the single point of leadership to centralize this function, streamline the organization, and uplevel the team.

You will be responsible for defining what analytics should be built across Sunrun and how to scale them. This includes leading the rollout of Sunrun’s core Data Hub and centralized SQL layer—establishing metric definitions, governance, and scoring standardizations across the entire company.

The ideal candidate brings experience from leading Tech environments (e.g., Meta, Stripe, fast-scaling consumer tech startups) where data directly drives revenue, customer impact, and operational efficiency in fast-moving, unstructured settings.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

Organizational Strategy, Centralization & Scale

* Unify & Streamline: Transition 20–30 distributed analysts across the business into a centralized, high-performing analytics org. Lead necessary org restructuring (streamlining down and upleveling capability) to build a lean, high-bar team.
* Thrive in Ambiguity: Build structure where none exists—design agile workflows, intake models, and clear prioritization frameworks to balance executive requests with scalable data products.
* Culture & Mentorship: Elevate analytical talent through hands-on technical coaching, career development, and setting a high technical bar for business intelligence.

Data Hub, SQL Layer & Metric Standardization

* Build the SQL Layer: Partner with Data Engineering on Sunrun's centralized Data Hub initiative. Own the enterprise SQL semantic layer, establishing canonical metrics, labeling standards, and standardized business definitions across all departments.
* Business Scoring & Frameworks: Design unified scoring models and frameworks across sales, consumer acquisition, and operational touchpoints to evaluate business performance accurately.
* Scalable Analytics Architecture: Architect reporting frameworks that scale—moving the company away from ad-hoc spreadsheets toward standardized, automated data products.

Business Partnership & Measurable Impact (Sales & Consumer)

* Drive Commercial Growth: Work closely with Sales, Consumer Experience, and Operations leaders to deliver actionable insights that directly move the needle on unit economics, sales funnel conversion, and customer LTV.
* Focus on Applied Analytics: Deliver practical, high-impact business analytics rather than theoretical or pure R&D data science.
* Executive Storytelling: Translate complex multidimensional data into clear executive dashboards, key performance metrics, and operational recommendations for executive leadership.

### **REQUIREMENTS (EDUCATION, EXPERIENCE, CERTIFICATIONS, AND OTHER SKILLS)**

  

* Experience: 8+ years of experience in Data Analytics, Business Intelligence, or Applied Data Science, with 3+ years in a team lead or management role overseeing analysts.
